name: Oji Holdings Corporation
summary: Oji Holdings Corporation manufactures and sells pulp and paper products in Japan, China, rest of Asia, North and South America, Europe, Oceania, and internationally. The Household and Industrial Materials segment offers corrugated containers, containerboard, special paperboard, boxboards, packaging paper, liquid paper cartons, filters, folding cartons, kraft heavy-duty sacks, insulation, paper bags, paper cores, and plastic trays.
